title: Comparative Studies on DNA-Binding Mechanisms between Enantiomers of a Polypyridyl Ruthenium(II) Complex.
authors: Nie, Yanhong; Dai, Zhongming; Fozia; Zhao, Guangyao; Jiang, Jianrong; Xu, Xu; Ying, Ming; Wang, Yu; Hu, Zhangli; Xu, Hong
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱、量热和分子模拟比较钌配合物对映体与DNA的嵌入结合机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，方法含分子模拟但非TF-DNA核心，可借鉴其手性识别与界面建模思路。
abstract: A pair of ruthenium(II) complex enantiomers, Delta- and Lambda-[Ru(bpy)(2)MBIP](2+) (bpy = 2,2'-bipyridine, MBIP = 2-(3-bromophenyl)imidazo[5,6-f]phenanthroline), were designed, synthesized, and characterized. Comparative studies between the enantiomers on their binding behaviors to calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) were conducted using UV-visible, fluorescence, and circular dichroism spectroscopies, viscosity measurements, isothermal titration calorimetry, a photocleavage experiment, and molecular simulation. The experimental results indicated that both the enantiomers spontaneously bound to CT-DNA through intercalation stabilized by the van der Waals force or the hydrogen bond and driven by enthalpy and that Delta-[Ru(bpy)(2)MBIP](2+) intercalated into DNA more deeply than Lambda-[Ru(bpy)(2)MBIP](2+) did and exhibited a better DNA photocleavage ability. Molecular simulation further indicated that Delta-[Ru(bpy)(2)MBIP](2+) more preferentially intercalated between the base pairs of CT-DNA to the major groove, and Lambda-[Ru(bpy)(2)MBIP](2+) more favorably intercalated to the minor groove. These research findings should be very helpful to the understanding of the stereoselectivity mechanism of DNA-bindings of metal complexes, and be useful for the design of novel metal-complex-based antitumor drugs with higher efficacy and lower toxicity.
abstract_zh: 设计、合成并表征了一对钌(II)配合物对映异构体，即Delta-和Lambda-[Ru(bpy)₂MBIP]²⁺（其中bpy = 2,2'-联吡啶，MBIP = 2-(3-溴苯基)咪唑并[5,6-f]菲咯啉）。通过紫外-可见光谱、荧光光谱、圆二色光谱、粘度测量、等温滴定量热法、光切割实验及分子模拟，对这两种对映异构体与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的结合行为进行了比较研究。实验结果表明，两种对映异构体均通过插入方式自发结合CT-DNA，该过程由范德华力或氢键稳定，并由焓驱动；其中Delta-[Ru(bpy)₂MBIP]²⁺比Lambda-[Ru(bpy)₂MBIP]²⁺插入DNA更深，并表现出更好的DNA光切割能力。分子模拟进一步表明，Delta-[Ru(bpy)₂MBIP]²⁺更倾向于插入CT-DNA碱基对之间的大沟，而Lambda-[Ru(bpy)₂MBIP]²⁺更倾向于插入小沟。这些研究发现应有助于理解金属配合物与DNA结合的手性选择性机制，并有助于设计具有更高疗效和更低毒性的新型金属配合物类抗肿瘤药物。
